payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the gating mechanism is specifically designed to handle one-sentence bags effectively, addressing issues that arise with selective attention in such cases.

claims.text: The proposed gating mechanism performs stably even with only one sentence in a bag, maintaining consistency across training examples.
The gating mechanism can dynamically align low gating values to wrongly labeled instances, preventing noise representation from propagating.
The model shows improved performance on one-sentence bags compared to selective attention mechanisms, which struggle in such scenarios.
